candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that zeroes the caller's balance after the payout, so balances retain their pre-withdraw value.
Move `balances[msg.sender]=0;` before the external call, so the payout value sent is zero instead of the balance.
Change the zeroing statement to set the caller's balance to 1 instead of 0 after a successful withdrawal.
Delete the statement resetting balances[msg.sender] to 0, so the balance is never cleared after withdrawal.
Delete the require check on the send result so a failed external call no longer reverts and the balance is zeroed regardless.
Move the balance reset to zero before the external call, so reentrant calls observe a zero balance.
Delete the statement setting __lock_modifier0_lock to true, effectively removing the reentrancy guard.
